content: When CanIf_Transmit() is called with PduInfoPtr->Sd- uLength less than 1 and the container CanIfTxPduCfg->CanIfTxPduXLParams is existing which indicates a CAN XL frame, and SDU Type is configured to a value different from 03h (tunneled CAN 2.0/FD frame), CanIf shall report runtime error code CANIF_E_DATA_LENGTH_MISMATCH to the Det_ReportRuntimeError() service of the DET .
